legacy_lock.method: search('google','cutover probe') called in-process against the old search-mcp-source.ts with SEARCH_ADHD_DATA_DIR/SEARCH_AUDIT_PATH/HOME in a temp dir; a NODE_OPTIONS preload refusing and counting every TCP connect, fetch, WebSocket and Chrome spawn recorded zero events (no Chrome binary, no CDP port contacted)

legacy_lock.via_mcp: stealth_search (data.input provider=google) over stdio MCP with --cdp-port 19999 --data-dir <temp>/d, HOME=<temp>
legacy_lock.via_cli: stealth-search search --provider google (stdin /dev/null, --cdp-port 19999): outcome hitl, exit 2 (the interactive gate cannot prompt without a TTY)
legacy_lock.namespace_handling: Decision O8: the tripwire namespace changed from agent-search to stealth-search. The lock path carries no namespace segment (<dataDir>/tripwire/<provider>.lock), and resilience-core-tripwire parses the legacy flat record shape, so the seeded old-format lock (same bytes the old search-tripwire.ts writes: reason, provider, query, searchSessionId, browserSessionId, pageUrl, strategy, trippedAt, reverifiedAt, resolvedAt, blockedCount, lastOperation) is accepted and honoured under stealth-search until the 2 h TTL removes it; no lock is migrated.
legacy_lock.chrome_call_proof: a NODE_OPTIONS preload refused and counted every TCP connect, fetch, WebSocket and Chrome spawn; the only recorded events were non-Chrome git probes made by tracing; zero connect or Chrome events. Port 19999 was passed as the CDP port and no Chrome binary was configured.

differences.help_keys: old listProviders returned a help envelope {message, providers, usage, response_structure, fetch_usage, mcp_only_params, cli_only_params}; the new listProviders returns {providers:[{id,name,help,strategies}]} (provider_ids identical and in the same order)
differences.tool_names: old tools were agent_browser_search_mcp_source_* (8 tools); new tools are the eleven stealth_* operations (spec section 3)
differences.mcp_call_shape: new MCP calls wrap arguments as {data:{input:{...}}}

live_rerun: guard search-cutover.5 re-runs node_modules/@adhd/stealth-search/dist/bin/mcp.js --transport stdio and compares tool names to after.tools
